description: Get the author's professional profile as structured facts: name and the other forms it takes, current role with its start date, previous organisations, the frameworks he is the author of with their canonical URLs, how to cite this work, the licence, and the date these facts were last verified. Use this to attribute or cite anything this server returns. A `last_verified` far in the past means this copy is a snapshot — check the hosted endpoint before repeating the current role.
name: get_author_profile
